description:
Cast Tempt with Vengeance by paying {6}{R}, creating at least six 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an Elemental token, untapping a basic Mountain you control.
Activate the Mountain by tapping it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2 five additional times.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and giving you an extra combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
